info.name: PdfCraft
info.summary: Edit PDFs in your Nextcloud with the PdfCraft PDF workbench
info.description:
Open any PDF in Files with **Edit in PdfCraft** and work on it right in the browser: annotate and comment, fill and sign forms, organize, combine and split pages, redact, add bookmarks, page numbers and watermarks, and more.
Saving writes the PDF straight back to Nextcloud (with file versions, so earlier states can be restored). **Save As** stores a copy in any folder you pick.
PdfCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly: documents are never sent to a third-party service, and the server needs no extra software.
PdfCraft (formerly PrintCraft) is an open-source, Rust-native PDF application: https://github.com/storytold/printcraft
info.author: Britton Couchman
